subject: planner: add generation of hash64 and equals for logical limit (#57238)
summary:
Reviewed commit diff (vs first parent) limited to planner changes: LogicalLimit switched from handwritten Hash64/Equals to generated implementations via struct tags, generator list/mapping updated, and a new hash/equals unit test added.

Looked for Blocker/High correctness/semantics risks in the new Hash64/Equals behavior. A potential Hash64/Equals invariant mismatch around nil vs empty PartitionBy slices (hash distinguished nil; equals initially didn’t) is addressed in later upstream/master history (Equals gains explicit nil-vs-non-nil checks), so there is no remaining Blocker/High issue in upstream/master attributable to this change.
